errors.browserCodeRequired.en: A valid browser code is required.
errors.browserCodeRequired.zh-CN: 需要有效的浏览器授权码。

errors.deviceLoginStartInvalid.en: The device login start request is invalid.
errors.deviceLoginStartInvalid.zh-CN: 设备登录启动请求无效。

errors.executionWorkspaceReopenedCannotA.en: Execution workspace was reopened and cannot be archived right now
errors.executionWorkspaceReopenedCannotA.zh-CN: 执行工作区已重新打开，暂时无法归档。

errors.invalidJsonBody.zh-CN: 无效的 JSON 请求体

errors.issueWorkspaceCannotReopen.en: This issue is linked to a closed workspace that cannot be reopened.
errors.issueWorkspaceCannotReopen.zh-CN: 此任务关联的已关闭工作区无法重新打开。

errors.issueWorkspaceReopenFailed.en: Could not reopen the workspace for this issue. Please try again.
errors.issueWorkspaceReopenFailed.zh-CN: 无法重新打开此任务的工作区，请重试。

errors.managedSandboxUnavailable.en: This instance runs agents only in its platform-managed sandbox, but no active managed sandbox environment exists. The test did not run.
errors.managedSandboxUnavailable.zh-CN: 此实例仅在平台托管的沙箱中运行智能体，但当前没有可用的托管沙箱环境，未执行测试。

errors.managedSandboxUnavailableRemediat.en: Restore the managed sandbox environment, then test again.
errors.managedSandboxUnavailableRemediat.zh-CN: 恢复托管沙箱环境后再试。

errors.setupTokenLoginUnsupported.en: This adapter does not support a setup-token login.
errors.setupTokenLoginUnsupported.zh-CN: 此智能体适配器不支持 setup-token 登录。

errors.updatedSinceInvalid.en: updatedSince must be a valid ISO 8601 timestamp when provided
errors.updatedSinceInvalid.zh-CN: 提供时，updatedSince 必须是有效的 ISO 8601 时间戳。

errors.workspaceRepairSeedManifestMalfor.en: Workspace seed manifest is malformed; repair source identity cannot be trusted.
errors.workspaceRepairSeedManifestMalfor.zh-CN: 工作区初始化清单格式无效，无法信任修复来源身份。

errors.workspaceRuntimePortAllocationExh.en: No safe automatically allocated runtime service port is available.
errors.workspaceRuntimePortAllocationExh.zh-CN: 没有可安全自动分配的运行时服务端口。

errors.workspaceRuntimePortAllocationRem.en: Retry the start or configure a different runtime service port.
errors.workspaceRuntimePortAllocationRem.zh-CN: 请重试启动，或配置其他运行时服务端口。
